SELECT r.*, p.name AS price_template_name, COALESCE(g.cnt, 0) AS suggested_count FROM ecom_reprice_rule r LEFT JOIN ecom_price_template p ON p.id = r.price_template_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT rule_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ecom_reprice_log WHERE status = 'SUGGESTED' GROUP BY rule_id) g ON g.rule_id = r.id
r.status = #{status.enabled} AND r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY r.id DESC
